citeAs: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu (2021). Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite Image Time Series with Convolutional Temporal Attention Networks. ICCV 2021.
creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu (LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN)
description: PASTIS is the first large-scale, publicly available Satellite Image Time Series (SITS) dataset with both semantic and panoptic annotations for agricultural parcel segmentation. It comprises 2,433 sequences of multi-spectral Sentinel-2 images (128×128 pixels, 10 spectral bands, 10m resolution) covering over 4,000 km² across four regions of France, with over 2 billion annotated pixels and 124,422 individualized parcels labeled with crop type and pixel-precise instance masks.
name: PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme Series)
publisher: IGN (Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière)
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The French Payment Agency estimates the accuracy of the crop annotations via in situ control over 98% and the relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were derived from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) produced by IGN. Each pixel was annotated with a semantic label from a nomenclature of 18 crop types plus background. The FLPIS 73-class breakdown was reduced to 18 classes by selecting classes with at least 400 parcels and samples in at least 2 of the 4 Sentinel-2 tiles. Parcels whose surface is more than 50% outside a patch are annotated with the void label. Pixel-precise parcel borders and bounding boxes were computed from the FLPIS data.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common crop classes. To mitigate this, patches with rare crop types were preferentially selected. The dataset covers four regions of France with diverse climates and crop distributions, covering almost 1% of the French Metropolitan territory, but is geographically limited to France. Approximately 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover.
rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were gathered from the THEIA data cluster (Copernicus/Sentinel-2 data processed by CNES). The dataset uses 4 different Sentinel-2 tiles covering different regions of French metropolitan territory. All available acquisitions between September 2018 and November 2019 were stacked per patch. Acquisitions with more than 90% cloud cover were automatically filtered by the Sentinel data provider. 2,433 patches (10% of all available patches) were selected, favoring patches with rare crop types to decrease class imbalance.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Acquisitions with more than 90% cloud cover were automatically filtered by the Sentinel data provider and not included. Even after this filtering, approximately 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover. The authors opted not to apply further preprocessing or cloud detection, leaving the raw data as-is to encourage methods that can handle such acquisitions. Temporal sampling is irregular due to both the orbit schedule of Sentinel-2 and the cloud-filtering policy, resulting in sequences of 33 to 61 acquisitions per patch.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 multi-spectral satellite images obtained from the open-access Sentinel-2 platform via THEIA (value-added data processed by CNES). Images have 13 spectral bands at 10m spatial resolution; atmospheric bands B01, B09, and B10 were excluded, leaving 10 bands. Parcel boundary and crop type annotations were sourced from the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS), as reported by farmers.
rai:dataImputationProtocol: For batch training on sequences of variable length, all-zeroes images are appended at the end of shorter sequences to match the length of the longer sequence in the batch. A padding mask is retained to prevent encoding of padded values and to exclude them from temporal averages.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is geographically limited to four regions of France. The class nomenclature is reduced to 18 crop types (from the original 73-class FLPIS breakdown), with parcels of other crop types annotated as void. The dataset is highly class-imbalanced (ratio over 50 between most and least common classes). Temporal sampling is irregular due to cloud filtering, with sequences ranging from 33 to 61 acquisitions. Approximately 28% of images have at least partial cloud cover.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: 2,433 patches were selected from approximately 24,000 available patches (about 10%), favoring patches with rare crop types to decrease the otherwise extreme class imbalance. The dataset is split into 5 folds for cross-validation, with a 1 km buffer between images to avoid cross-fold contamination. Folds were chosen to have comparable class distributions (measured by pairwise Kullback-Leibler divergence) and to include patches from all four Sentinel tiles.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Sentinel-2 images underwent atmospheric correction and resampling to a spatial resolution of 10 meters per pixel by THEIA. Atmospheric spectral bands (B01, B09, B10) were removed, retaining 10 bands. Acquisitions with more than 90% cloud cover were automatically filtered by the satellite data provider. Patches of 128×128 pixels (1.28×1.28 km) were extracted from the 100×100 km Sentinel tiles. Parcel extents were cropped along patch boundaries and bounding boxes adjusted accordingly.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Remote monitoring of the surface and nature of agricultural parcels is necessary for fair allocation of agricultural subsidies (50 and 22 billion euros per year in Europe and the US, respectively) and for ensuring that best crop rotation practices are respected. The dataset enables automated analysis of satellite image time series for applications including surveying urban development and deforestation.
rai:dataUseCases: Panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels from satellite image time series; semantic segmentation of crop types; instance segmentation of agricultural fields; crop mapping for monitoring agricultural subsidies allocation and crop rotation practices; Earth observation and remote sensing research.

null_reasons.rai:annotationsPerItem: Annotations are derived programmatically from the FLPIS (a single authoritative source), not from multiple independent annotators per item.
null_reasons.rai:annotatorDemographics: Annotations are derived from the French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) as reported by farmers; no human annotator demographics are described.
null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Annotations were sourced from the French LPIS (an existing government database), not an annotation platform.
null_reasons.rai:machineAnnotationTools: No machine annotation tools are described; annotations come directly from the French LPIS government database.
null_reasons.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains satellite imagery and agricultural parcel data; no personal or sensitive information about individuals is described.
null_reasons.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: No versioning, update cadence, or maintenance plan is described in the paper.
null_reasons.license: No license is explicitly stated in the paper; will check HuggingFace/GitHub in Phase 2.
